prompt_text:
Task: Managed Model Platform Workflow

Write code that resolves a provider-specific model, deployment, or inference resource before invocation using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Hugging Face:
  Service: Hugging Face Inference Providers
  SDK: huggingface_hub
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: InferenceClient
  Setup hints: HF_TOKEN
  Official docs: https://huggingface.co/docs/inference-providers/index

Option 2 — Amazon Bedrock:
  Service: Amazon Bedrock
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: invoke_model, converse
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/models-api-compatibility.html

Option 3 — IBM watsonx.ai:
  Service: watsonx.ai
  SDK: ibm-watsonx-ai
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: text/chat, deployments
  Setup hints: WATSONX_API_KEY, WATSONX_PROJECT_ID
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/apidocs/watsonx-ai-cp

Option 4 — Vertex AI:
  Service: Vertex AI generative models
  SDK: vertexai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: GenerativeModel, generate_content
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs

Option 5 — Alibaba Model Studio:
  Service: Model Studio / DashScope
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: Generation.call
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/what-is-model-studio

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
import os
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional

import boto3
from botocore.exceptions import BotoCoreError, ClientError


def _resolve_bedrock_model_id(model_name: str, region_name: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
    """
    Resolve a provider-specific Amazon Bedrock model identifier before invocation.

    Supports either:
      - a concrete Bedrock model ID, e.g. "anthropic.claude-3-haiku-20240307-v1:0"
      - a short alias resolved from a small curated map

    If the input is already a plausible Bedrock model ID, it is returned unchanged.
    """
    curated_map = {
        "claude-3-haiku": "anthropic.claude-3-haiku-20240307-v1:0",
        "claude-3-sonnet": "anthropic.claude-3-sonnet-20240229-v1:0",
        "claude-3-opus": "anthropic.claude-3-opus-20240229-v1:0",
        "claude-3.5-sonnet": "anthropic.claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620-v1:0",
        "llama3-8b": "meta.llama3-8b-instruct-v1:0",
        "llama3-70b": "meta.llama3-70b-instruct-v1:0",
        "mistral-large": "mistral.mistral-large-2407-v1:0",
    }

    if "." in model_name and ":" in model_name:
        return model_name

    if model_name in curated_map:
        return curated_map[model_name]

    raise ValueError(
        f"Unknown model alias '{model_name}'. Provide a concrete Bedrock model ID "
        f"or one of: {', '.join(sorted(curated_map))}."
    )


def invoke_managed_model(
    prompt: str,
    model_name: Optional[str] = None,
    region_name: Optional[str] = None,
    max_tokens: int = 256,
    temperature: float = 0.7,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Resolve a Bedrock model identifier and invoke it using the Amazon Bedrock Runtime API.
    """
    region = region_name or os.getenv("AWS_REGION") or os.getenv("AWS_DEFAULT_REGION") or "us-east-1"
    resolved_model_id = _resolve_bedrock_model_id(
        model_name or "anthropic.claude-3-haiku-20240307-v1:0",
        region_name=region,
    )

    client = boto3.client("bedrock-runtime", region_name=region)

    body = {
        "anthropic_version": "bedrock-2023-05-31",
        "max_tokens": max_tokens,
        "temperature": temperature,
        "messages": [
            {
                "role": "user",
                "content": [{"type": "text", "text": prompt}],
            }
        ],
    }

    try:
        response = client.invoke_model(
            modelId=resolved_model_id,
            body=bytes(str(body).replace("'", '"'), "utf-8"),
            contentType="application/json",
            accept="application/json",
        )
        raw = response["body"].read().decode("utf-8")
    except (BotoCoreError, ClientError) as exc:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Bedrock invocation failed for model '{resolved_model_id}': {exc}") from exc

    import json

    parsed = json.loads(raw)
    text_parts = []
    for content_item in parsed.get("content", []):
        if isinstance(content_item, dict) and content_item.get("type") == "text":
            text_parts.append(content_item.get("text", ""))
    output_text = "".join(text_parts)

    return {
        "provider": "amazon-bedrock",
        "region": region,
        "model_id": resolved_model_id,
        "output_text": output_text,
        "raw_response": parsed,
    }
